summary: Tested Vetrina (Showcase) feature end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests pass (public visibility rules, date window filtering, admin CRUD, reorder, permissions 403 for listener, News regression intact). Frontend: guest Home shows testID 'showcase-section' with 2 demo cards (showcase-card-showcase_demo1/demo2), both CTAs (showcase-cta-*) visible, Notizie bottom tab still works. Admin /admin/showcase lists 2 rows with active toggles + up/down arrows + create button; new card creation via editor (all showcase-* testIDs present: title, desc, image, cat-*, cta-text, cta-url, start, end, active, save, delete) saves and appears in list; delete flow removes it. No blocking issues.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: ShowcaseCarousel autoplay resume timer (RESUME_MS 9s) is reset on every momentum scroll end which is fine, but if a user swipes and doesn't scroll again there's no explicit signal on drag-end for touch-hold. Acceptable behavior.
Non-blocking: harmless console warning 'GO_BACK not handled' fires when logging in from a fresh /login navigation (root gate redirects). Pre-existing, not introduced by Vetrina.
seed_data_creation: None persistent; test_showcase.py creates + deletes its own TEST_-prefixed cards. UI test also created and deleted one TEST_UI_Vetrina card. DB left with the 2 original demo cards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vetrina feature validated. Seeded cards: showcase_demo1 (Concerto/MUSICA), showcase_demo2 (Raccolta fondi/PROGETTO), both active with cta_url. Public /api/showcase returns them in order 0,1. Admin token ADMINTESTTOKEN123 works for /api/admin/showcase. Email login for FE admin: pescatoridiuomini@outlook.it / AdminTestPwd1!. Notizie tab remains unchanged (/api/news + /news screen).
